summary: BBB Foods Inc. (Tiendas 3B) filed a Form 6-K announcing a proposed follow-on public offering of 13,304,174 Class A common shares, with 700,000 shares from the company and 12,604,174 from selling shareholders, plus a 30-day underwriter option for up to 1,995,626 additional shares from the issuer. The offering, subject to market conditions, will use proceeds for general corporate purposes and strategic investments. J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley are global coordinators; BTG Pactual, Santander, and Scotiabank are joint bookrunners. No price, premium, or close date is specified. This is a registered secondary offering, not a special situation.
